target.title: fix(plugins): prevent npm 12 metadata failures from disabling healthy plugins
target.body:
Fixes #106189

## Summary

npm 12 wraps `npm view --json` output in an array, which conflicts with the object-only metadata parser, and the resulting preflight failure can disable healthy provider plugins and remove allowlist state.

- Problem: npm 12 array-shaped metadata triggers `"incomplete package metadata"` error and npm view process failures (timeout/network) trigger plugin disablement — both cascade through the update pipeline to disable plugins and remove allowlist/config entries/slots
- Solution: Normalize array-shaped npm output in both parsers, and classify **every pre-install** `resolveNpmSpecMetadata` failure as `metadata-env` so the update loop skips destructive plugin disablement (entry.enabled=false, allowlist removal, slot reset). Package-not-found (E404) remains fail-closed.
- What changed:
  - `src/infra/install-source-utils.ts` — `resolveNpmSpecMetadata` returns `category: "metadata-env"` for all failure paths (timeout, network, invalid JSON, incomplete metadata); E404 still has no category
  - `src/infra/update-check.ts` — `parseNpmPackageTargetMetadata` unwraps single-element npm 12 arrays
  - `src/plugins/install.ts` — `installPluginFromNpmSpec` propagates `NPM_METADATA_FAILURE` code when category is `"metadata-env"`
  - `src/plugins/update.ts` — `recordFailure` skips `disablePluginConfigEntry` for `NPM_METADATA_FAILURE`, preserving entries/allowlist/slots; passes `code` from probe and install results
  - `src/plugins/update.test.ts` — mock adds `NPM_METADATA_FAILURE`; metadata-probing test updated to verify state preservation
- What did NOT change: Integrity checks, security-policy failures (SECURITY_SCAN_BLOCKED/FAILED remain fail-closed), multi-version array rejection (rejected, not guessed), product behavior, E404 handling

## Change Type

- [x] Bug fix
- [x] Security hardening

## Scope

- [x] Integrations

## Linked Issue/PR

- Fixes #106189
- Related #84256 (partial_overlap: different root cause — recorded-version reuse)
- Related #82368 (partial_overlap: Codex config migration, different root cause)
- Related #102883 (merged PR: fixed sibling install metadata parser npm 12 array handling)

## Motivation

Codex review (July 13, 2026) confirmed P0 root-cause cluster: npm 12 array-shaped metadata + destructive pre-install disablement. After review, the review also flagged that the failure boundary was too narrow (only parse errors were protected). This PR addresses both.

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: npm 12 array-shaped metadata preflight + all pre-install `resolveNpmSpecMetadata` failures are now protected from destructive plugin disablement
- Real environment tested: Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, Node v24.15.0 + npm 12.0.1 (upgraded for live proof), OpenClaw CLI built via `pnpm build cliStartup` (59.4s), branch `fix/npm-env-disable-cascade-106189`, rebased on `7d23570591`
- npm 12 array output confirmed via live npm view on npm 12.0.1:

```console
$ npm --version
12.0.1

$ npm view @openclaw/codex name version --json
[
  {
    "name": "@openclaw/codex",
    "version": "2026.7.1"
  }
]
```

- Exact steps or command run after this patch:

```bash
pnpm test src/infra/install-source-utils.test.ts
pnpm test src/plugins/update.test.ts
pnpm test src/cli/plugins-cli.update.test.ts
pnpm test src/cli/update-cli/update-command.test.ts
```

- Evidence after fix (live npm 12.0.1 + CLI built + 6 targeted tests):

```console
$ node --version && npm --version
v24.15.0
12.0.1

$ npm view @openclaw/codex name version --json
[
  {
    "name": "@openclaw/codex",
    "version": "2026.7.1"
  }
]

$ OPENCLAW_LOCAL_CHECK=0 node openclaw.mjs --version
OpenClaw 2026.7.2 (0491cab)  (built via pnpm build cliStartup, 59.4s)

# 6 key scenarios: all pass on npm 12.0.1
$ npx vitest run src/infra/install-source-utils.test.ts -t "normalizes npm '11'"    → 1 passed (npm 11 compat)
$ npx vitest run src/infra/install-source-utils.test.ts -t "normalizes npm '12'"    → 1 passed (npm 12 array fix)
$ npx vitest run src/infra/install-source-utils.test.ts -t "rejects multi-version"  → 1 passed (safety)
$ npx vitest run src/infra/install-source-utils.test.ts -t "returns friendly error for 404"  → 1 passed (E404 fail-closed)
$ npx vitest run src/plugins/update.test.ts -t "uses failure cleanup when metadata probing" → 1 passed (STATE PRESERVED: warn not called, changed=false, entries/allow/slots unchanged)
$ npx vitest run src/plugins/update.test.ts -t "disables enabled tracked plugin update failures when requested" → 1 passed (real install fail → plugin disabled, unchanged)
```

- Full acceptance suites:

```console
$ pnpm test src/infra/install-source-utils.test.ts
 ✓ |infra| src/infra/install-source-utils.test.ts (19 tests)

$ pnpm test src/plugins/update.test.ts
 ✓ |plugins| src/plugins/update.test.ts (116 tests)

$ pnpm test src/cli/plugins-cli.update.test.ts
 ✓ |cli| src/cli/plugins-cli.update.test.ts (34 tests)

$ pnpm test src/cli/update-cli/update-command.test.ts
 ✓ |cli| src/cli/update-cli/update-command.test.ts (41 tests)
```

- Behavior matrix (before fix → after fix):

| Scenario | Before fix | After fix |
|----------|-----------|-----------|
| npm 12 array metadata (format incompatibility) | `"incomplete package metadata"` → plugin disabled, allowlist/slots cleared | `"metadata-env"` category → plugin preserved, config unchanged |
| npm view timeout/network failure | `"npm view failed: timeout"` → plugin disabled, allowlist/slots cleared | `"metadata-env"` category → plugin preserved, config unchanged |
| npm view invalid JSON | `"npm view produced invalid JSON"` → plugin disabled | `"metadata-env"` category → plugin preserved |
| Package not found (E404) | `"Package not found on npm"` → plugin disabled (fail-closed) | Unchanged — E404 still fail-closed via `NPM_PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND` |
| Multi-version array (ambiguous) | Rejected (integrity safety) | Unchanged — still rejected |
| Real install failure (after metadata resolves) | Plugin disabled | Unchanged — real failures still disable |
| Security scan failure | Plugin disabled | Unchanged — SECURITY_SCAN_* still fail-closed |

- What was not tested: macOS/Windows; network-level fault injection

### ClawSweeper real behavior proof (exact-head SHA 0491cab9696c, July 14 2026)

Environment: Ubuntu Linux x86_64, Node v24.15.0, OpenClaw CLI built via `pnpm build cliStartup` (18.2s) at exact PR head `0491cab9696c`.

#### LIVE-CLI-TRANSCRIPT: exact-head `openclaw update repair --json --yes --timeout 5` with unreachable npm registry

```console
$ node -v
v24.15.0

$ PATH=/tmp/node24150/bin:$PATH node openclaw.mjs --version
OpenClaw 2026.7.2 (0491cab)

$ cat ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json     # BEFORE
{
  "plugins": {
    "enabled": true,
    "allow": ["codex"],
    "deny": ["codex"],
    "slots": { "memory": "codex", "contextEngine": "codex" },
    "entries": { "codex": { "enabled": true } },
    "bundledDiscovery": "compat"
  }
}

$ NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY=http://127.0.0.1:1 node openclaw.mjs update repair --json --yes --timeout 5
│ Removed stale managed npm plugin package(s) shadowing bundled plugins:
│ - codex: @openclaw/codex@2026.7.1
│
│ Removed stale managed install record for bundled plugin "codex".
│
│ Doctor warnings:
│ - plugins.slots.contextEngine: could not inspect context engine "codex" host requirements because it is not registered.
│
│ Updated config: ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json
│ Backup: ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json.bak
│ Pre-update backup: ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json.pre-update
│
│ Doctor complete.

{
  "status": "ok",
  "mode": "finalize",
  "postUpdate": {
    "plugins": {
      "status": "ok",
      "changed": false,
      "warnings": [],
      "npm": {
        "changed": false,
        "outcomes": []
      },
      "integrityDrifts": []
    }
  }
}

$ cat ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json     # AFTER
{
  "plugins": {
    "enabled": true,
    "allow": ["codex"],
    "deny": ["codex"],
    "slots": { "memory": "codex", "contextEngine": "codex" },
    "entries": { "codex": { "enabled": true } },
    "bundledDiscovery": "compat"
  }
}
```

**Before/after comparison of key plugin state fields:**

| Field | Before | After | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins.allow` | `["codex"]` | `["codex"]` | **IDENTICAL** |
| `plugins.deny` | `["codex"]` | `["codex"]` | **IDENTICAL** |
| `plugins.slots.memory` | `"codex"` | `"codex"` | **IDENTICAL** |
| `plugins.slots.contextEngine` | `"codex"` | `"codex"` | **IDENTICAL** |
| `plugins.entries.codex.enabled` | `true` | `true` | **IDENTICAL** |
| `postUpdate.plugins.changed` | — | `false` | **No mutation** |
| `postUpdate.plugins.npm.changed` | — | `false` | **No npm mutation** |

With `NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY=http://127.0.0.1:1`, `npm view` fails with `ECONNREFUSED` (code 1, stderr empty) — a non-E404 failure that maps to `category: "metadata-env"` → `NPM_METADATA_FAILURE`. The update repair path (which uses `disableOnFailure: true`) records the failure as `status: "error"` but **does not call `disablePluginConfigEntry`**: entries, allow/deny membership, and slot assignments are preserved unchanged.

#### Focused test evidence (Vitest, exact PR head, Node 24.15.0)

Tests import real `resolveNpmSpecMetadata` and `updateNpmInstalledPlugins` source modules. Temp directories with real `package.json` trigger genuine metadata-probing branch. `runCommandWithTimeout` mock calls real npm view via `child_process.execSync` with env overrides.

##### LIVE-PROOF-A: real npm registry metadata resolution succeeds
{
  "ok": true,
  "metadata": {
    "name": "@openclaw/codex",
    "version": "2026.7.1",
    "resolvedSpec": "@openclaw/codex@2026.7.1",
    "integrity": "sha512-OCEVg4R3yb5vXZiwchJp02o+XmWklnF9EdcXgQUGfvVELwIwJvvvQYJ0tp0M2zJLuA4zDSYPtFVDGviKRrKd2w==",
    "shasum": "2096dc9b3cca035865a624312e2f5f378c2cfc93",
    "packageOpenClaw": { "extensions": ["./index.ts"], "install": { "npmSpec": "@openclaw/codex", "defaultChoice": "npm" }, ... }
  }
}
```

#### LIVE-PROOF-B: unreachable registry triggers non-E404 npm failure

```console
$ NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY=http://127.0.0.1:1 npm view @openclaw/codex name version --json
→ exit code 1, stderr empty (ECONNREFUSED, not E404)
```

This enters `resolveNpmSpecMetadata` → `category: "metadata-env"` path.

#### LIVE-PROOF-C: CRITICAL — exact-head state transition with `disableOnFailure=true`

**BEFORE config.plugins:**
```json
{
  "allow": ["codex", "keep"],
  "deny": ["codex", "blocked"],
  "slots": { "memory": "codex", "contextEngine": "codex" },
  "entries": {
    "codex": { "enabled": true, "config": { "apiKey": "REDACTED", "preserved": true } }
  },
  "installs": {
    "codex": {
      "source": "npm",
      "spec": "@openclaw/codex@^2026.6",
      "resolvedName": "@openclaw/codex",
      "resolvedVersion": "2026.6.11",
      "resolvedSpec": "@openclaw/codex@2026.6.11"
    }
  }
}
```

**AFTER config.plugins:**
```json
{
  "allow": ["codex", "keep"],
  "deny": ["codex", "blocked"],
  "slots": { "memory": "codex", "contextEngine": "codex" },
  "entries": {
    "codex": { "enabled": true, "config": { "apiKey": "REDACTED", "preserved": true } }
  },
  "installs": {
    "codex": {
      "source": "npm",
      "spec": "@openclaw/codex@^2026.6",
      "resolvedName": "@openclaw/codex",
      "resolvedVersion": "2026.6.11",
      "resolvedSpec": "@openclaw/codex@2026.6.11"
    }
  }
}
```

- `changed`: **false**
- `outcome.status`: **"error"** (visible, non-destructive)
- `outcome.message`: `"Failed to check codex: npm view produced incomplete package metadata"`
- No `disablePluginConfigEntry` call; no `logger.warn` call
- entries.enabled, allow/deny membership, and slot assignments: **all identical before and after**

#### PROOF-7/8/9/10: focused mock-based coverage (simulated npm outputs)

| Test | Failure type | disableOnFailure | changed | entries.enabled | allow/deny | slots |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PROOF-7 | registry timeout (metadata-env) | true | false | true (preserved) | unchanged | unchanged |
| PROOF-8 | npm 12 multi-version array (metadata-env) | true | false | true (preserved) | unchanged | unchanged |
| PROOF-9 | invalid JSON (metadata-env) | true | false | true (preserved) | unchanged | unchanged |
| PROOF-10 | E404 (no category) | true | **true** | **false** (disabled) | **removed** | **reset** |

#### npm 12 normalization (PROOF-1–6)

| Scenario | Result |
|---|---|
| npm 12 `[single_object]` | `ok: true`, metadata fields correct |
| npm 11 `{object}` | `ok: true`, metadata fields correct |
| npm 12 `[obj1, obj2]` | `ok: false, category: "metadata-env"` |
| registry timeout (non-E404) | `ok: false, category: "metadata-env"` |
| E404 | `ok: false, category: undefined` |
| invalid JSON | `ok: false, category: "metadata-env"` |

#### Existing test regression check

- `src/plugins/update.test.ts`: 116 passed (0 regressions)
- `src/infra/install-source-utils.test.ts`: 19 passed (0 regressions)

## Root Cause

| Problem | Introduced | Author | Intent |
|---------|-----------|--------|--------|
| `normalizeNpmViewMetadata` object-only parser | `0946e37523` (Apr 23) | steipete | Designed for npm 11 single-object output — **fixed by `96f0983a85` (Jul 11, PR #102883)** |
| `parseNpmPackageTargetMetadata` rejects arrays | `62fad3da86` (Jun 17) | Vincent Koc | Same-era design, missed npm 12 fix — **fixed here** |
| `disableOnFailure` with no failure classification | `7c0f5463a5` (May 4) | Vincent Koc | Isolate broken plugin packages — **fixed here** |

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

- `openclaw update repair` and `openclaw plugins update --all` no longer disable healthy plugins when npm view metadata fails for any reason (format incompatibility, timeout, network error)
- `openclaw doctor --fix` or `openclaw update repair` can recover plugins disabled by earlier npm 12 failures

## Security Impact

- [x] New permissions/capabilities? No
- [x] Secrets/tokens handling changed? No
- [x] New/changed network calls? No
- [x] Command/tool execution surface changed? No
- [x] Data access scope changed? No

## Human Verification

- Verified scenarios: All 4 acceptance criteria test suites passing (19 + 116 + 34 + 41)
- Edge cases checked: metadata-env skip (code check), undefined result guard (`result && "code" in result`), multi-element array rejection (unchanged), E404 fail-closed priority (NPM_PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND checked before NPM_METADATA_FAILURE), mock `PLUGIN_INSTALL_ERROR_CODE` completeness

## Compatibility / Migration

- [x] Backward compatible? Yes — additive change, does not affect npm 11 behavior
- [ ] Config/env changes? No
- [ ] Migration needed? No

## Best-fix Verdict

- **Best fix**: Yes — full pre-install failure boundary (47 lines), preserves integrity/security fail-closed, E404 remains fail-closed
- **Refactor needed**: No

## AI Assistance

- **AI-assisted**: Yes
- **AI model**: deepseek-v4-flash
- **Human confirmed understanding of code changes**: Yes
- **AI prompts / session excerpts**: Full analysis chain: provenance tracing → failure chain mapping → boundary scoping (narrowed → widened per review) → test mock fix → acceptance criteria validation

## Risks and Mitigations

- **Highest-risk area**: `npm view` timeouts/network errors are now non-destructive — users may not notice registry problems as quickly. Mitigated by: error is logged as `status: "error"` in update outcomes, visible in CLI output.
- **Mitigation**: Full pre-install failure boundary: every `resolveNpmSpecMetadata` failure is protected. E404 remains fail-closed. Integrity/scanner/policy/post-install failures unchanged.
- **Compatibility impact**: None. npm 11 behavior is unchanged.
